analysis.narrativeEn:

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.2520 → -0.2890): steady worsening, indicating bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $68.54): approaching lower band, with band width narrowing to 5.40%.

· Swing resistance ($68.83): confirmed resistance based on SMA50, potential trend reversal upon breakout.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.46): contracted volume, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): buy entry conditions not met, maintaining a wait-and-see stance.
